# HEM v0.8.6b4 – Show or hide individual trend lines

Tap a measurement, HEM target, PID demand, device output or sensor limit to hide its line and markers. Its label and value turn grey. Tap again to restore its color and see its value at the cursor.

Each series can be toggled independently, including the low and high limits of a target range. Your selection follows you across time ranges while the trend window is open.
